messages:
alice: FYI handoff — we have an ongoing spike in DB retry errors since ~1799991100. Error rate peaked ~3x baseline and is causing elevated latency for tokenstore/kv reads which cascades into slow tail latencies for hosted inference customers. paging was triggered at 1799991205. Primary = matt, Secondary = carla. Current mitigations listed below.

incident-bot: ALERT: db-retry-rate-high (prod-tokenstore) — page sent to #oncall + matt at 1799991205. Summary: 500-level retry throttles observed on redis cluster x.

matt: Quick summary — root cause unknown, symptoms look like connection saturation to redis cluster shard-7. We've scoped: ~12% of requests see retries, 5% of requests get 503 after retry. Affects hosted inference and Dedicated customers in us-west.

carla: Observed repeated `i/o timeout` and `ERR maxclients` in redis logs. Also seeing increased queue length in inference sidecar (kv cache miss stalls).

jamal: Actions taken so far: scaled up redis shard-7 by +2 nodes at 1799991320 (manual), bumped connection pool to 200 in tokenstore at 1799991365, enabled short-circuit cache for top-10 prefixes (experimental) at 1799991402.

matt: Running a rolling restart of the tokenstore pool to flush stuck clients. Command used: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/tokenstore --selector=shard=7``` Started 1799991420.

carla: Monitoring: tail logs show `maxclients` events dropped after scale ~5m later. Retry rate decreased from 3x -> ~1.3x. Latency p95 for generation still elevated due to KV misses, but trending down.

alice: Customer impact: a handful of active tenants on Hosted are seeing errory responses and slow streaming. No enterprise SLA breach yet, but risk if we don't finish mitigation. Open tickets: CS-4521 (high), CS-4522 (medium).

matt: Outstanding: confirm persistence layer health (redis metrics ok), verify tokenstore restarts finish without crash loops, run a controlled rollback of connection pool changes if instability observed. Also want to run `INFO clients` and `SLOWLOG` on shard-7 post-restart.

incident-bot: NOTE: next on-call at 1799992000 is jamal (primary) and tina (secondary). Pager schedule link: https://oncall.example/redwood/schedule

carla: Coverage gap: weekend rotation has fewer infra engineers on-call; if shard-7 shows degradation after 22:00 PDT we should escalate to infra-ops pager. Also our automated failover for shard-7 to standby is currently disabled (ticket INF-788).

matt: Runbook pointers for next shift: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/tokenstore-db-retry (see sections "Immediate mitigation" and "Failover checklist"). Short checklist to hand off: 1) watch `redis.clients.connected_clients`, 2) monitor `tokenstore.errors.rate` dashboard, 3) keep connection pool at 200 while testing, 4) if retries > 2% for >10m trigger infra-ops.

jamal: Notes on diagnostics: attached commands I ran: ```redis-cli -h shard7.prod.cluster INFO clients``` and ```kubectl logs -n infra tokenstore-xyz | grep "maxclients"``` Also collected slowlogs: `SLOWLOG GET 50` showed spikes at 1799991280-1799991310.

alice: Handoff to night shift (matt -> jamal): please pick up active mitigations if still in progress. Priorities: (A) confirm no new 503 customers, (B) complete redis metric post-mortem capture, (C) coordinate with CS to update affected customers if incident persists.

matt: I will leave an open monitoring query in the dashboard with alert thresholds: `tokenstore.retry_rate > 0.02` for 10m. If it fires, escalate to infra-ops and call on-call infra lead (pager). CLI to silence noisy alerts temporarily: `alertctl mute tokenstore-retries 15m --by=incident-1799991234` — use sparingly.

carla: If you need to revert the connection pool bump: patch snippet: ```- name: TOKENSTORE_CONN_POOL
  value: "100"  # revert to stable
``` Apply with `kubectl apply -f tokenstore-configmap.yaml` and then rollout restart.

jamal: I'll be primary from 1799992000 onward. My contact: @jamal (pager) + mobile. If I need infra escalation, paging infra oncall: +1-800-555-0100 (use infra contact matrix in runbook).

alice: Final notes for whoever picks this up: current status = mitigations applied, retry rate trending down but not fully recovered. Keep customer comms minimal until we confirm stable p95. Document any additional changes in the incident thread. I'll add a small post-handoff checklist in the incident ticket. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: THREAD SUMMARY: ongoing DB retry spike — mitigations: scale shard, increased pool, tokenstore restarts. Next shift: jamal primary, tina secondary. Open actions: verify stability and capture metrics.
